common_pdf.probe_source:
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__,aw.__file__
root=Path('/tmp/docweave-current-performance');results={}
for case in ('small','hundred_pages','image_table','repeated_images','mixed_styles'):
 raw=aw.Document(root/(case+'.docx')).to_bytes(aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions())
 pages=[]
 with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
  for page in pdf:
   pages.append({key:hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest() for key,value in {'words':repr(page.get_text('words')).encode(),'pixels':page.get_pixmap().samples,'drawings':repr(page.get_drawings()).encode(),'images':repr(page.get_image_info()).encode()}.items()})
 results[case]={'bytes':len(raw),'pages':pages}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print('five PDF corpora saved')
